items.title: Ontology-Grounded Project Memory for Coding Agents
items.title_zh: 面向编码智能体的本体锚定项目记忆
items.summary: MOOSEDev gives coding agents structured, ontology-grounded project memory, capturing architectural decisions, lessons, constraints and rationales in a knowledge graph exposed through an MCP interface, with lifecycle status, provenance and supersession links. On 835 typed records it returned the expected answer set almost fully (0.98–1.00) for supersession, set-completeness and negation questions, versus 6%–27% for a production vector-memory tool's top-k retrieval.

items.title: WeChat's Xiaowei Agent Runs on WeLM — a Sparse MoE Model Quietly Growing to 617 Billion Parameters
items.title_zh: 微信“小薇”智能体基于 WeLM：稀疏 MoE 模型悄然增至 6170 亿参数
items.summary: WeChat has begun gray-testing Xiaowei, a native AI assistant inside the app powered by WeLM. According to Pandaily, WeLM has moved to a sparse mixture-of-experts architecture whose 617-billion-parameter version activates just 23 billion parameters per token.

items.title: TeachMateGPT: A Multi-Agent Knowledge-Grounded Framework for Pedagogical Assessment Generation from Science Curriculum Materials
items.title_zh: TeachMateGPT：基于科学课程材料生成教学评估的多智能体知识锚定框架
items.summary: TeachMateGPT is a multi-agent system for generating textbook-grounded science assessments, combining a hierarchical curriculum knowledge base (COPE), a fail-closed staged agent pipeline, and a source-attributed verification protocol (SAVER). It raises faithfulness from 0.68 to 0.96 and answer relevancy from 0.60 to 0.89 over a vanilla RAG baseline.

items.title: TraVEL: Trajectory-Guided Video Embedding Learning for Driving-Video Retrieval
items.title_zh: TraVEL：面向驾驶视频检索的轨迹引导视频嵌入学习
items.summary: TraVEL fine-tunes a general-purpose multimodal embedding model for driving-video retrieval, using ego-trajectory similarity as a reward in GRPO because caption supervision alone misses fine-grained motion understanding. Relative to supervised fine-tuning it raises longitudinal and lateral mAP by 9.8 and 4.7 points at 2B, and by 7.2 and 1.5 points at 8B.

items.title: AaLLM: An End-to-End Analog Circuit Design Framework from Topology Generation to Sizing Using Large Language Models
items.title_zh: AaLLM：从拓扑生成到尺寸优化的端到端模拟电路设计框架
items.summary: AaLLM is an open-source multi-agent LLM workflow that turns user specifications into a netlist, covering both topology generation and circuit sizing. It builds a RAG knowledge base from papers and textbooks and uses Designer, Critic and Evaluator agents, reporting 3x–4.5x fewer SPICE calls at inference and 40x lower wall-clock time than existing multi-agent pipelines.

items.title: CLAIR-Fin: An Adversarial Multi-Agent Framework for Claim-Level Verification and Adaptive Debate in Cross-Modal Financial QA
items.title_zh: CLAIR-Fin：跨模态金融问答中主张级验证与自适应辩论的对抗多智能体框架
items.summary: CLAIR-Fin is a nine-agent framework that decomposes financial questions into atomic claims held in a typed Claim Ledger, with claim-type-specific evidence authority, hand-off verification and adaptive adversarial debate. On the 500-question BB-FinQA-X set it raises faithfulness from 0.780 to 0.889 over single-pass RAG, abstaining on 5.4% of questions when evidence is insufficient.

items.title: MARC v1: An Open-Source Multi-Agent Framework for Clinical AI Reasoning and Coordination
items.title_zh: MARC v1：面向临床 AI 推理与协作的开源多智能体框架
items.summary: MARC is an open-source framework that replaces monolithic LLM prompting with deterministic multi-agent orchestration for clinical reasoning, coordinating extraction, reasoning, answer-generation and evaluation agents with traceable intermediate outputs. It adds a Decomposer that generates task-specific agent prompts from plain language and is configured entirely through YAML, with API-based and local CPU deployments.

items.title: The builder’s guide to GPT‑5.6
items.summary: OpenAI's builder guide describes how startups use GPT-5.6 to build faster, more cost-efficient AI agents, with guidance on model selection and new Responses API capabilities.

items.title: Agent 开始干正事，大厂终于给它装上了质检线
items.title_zh: Agent 开始干正事，大厂终于给它装上了质检线
items.summary: The article reports that major technology companies are building quality-inspection and evaluation mechanisms for AI agents, so that agents can move from demonstrations into usable real business scenarios.

items.title: Alibaba Cloud Launches Qwen AI Arena for Real-World Agent Testing
items.title_zh: 阿里云发布 Qwen AI Arena：真实场景智能体评测平台
items.summary: Alibaba Cloud launched Qwen AI Arena, a challenge and evaluation platform for AI agents that builds tasks from real business scenarios and supplies models, runtime environments and evaluation tools. Its first challenge focuses on customer service.

items.title: WPS Quietly Launches Lingxi Pro, an AI-Native Office Agent That Turns Skills into Editable Documents
items.title_zh: WPS 悄然上线 Lingxi Pro：原生 AI 办公智能体
items.summary: Kingsoft's WPS quietly launched Lingxi Pro, a standalone AI-native office agent that makes AI the first entry point rather than a document feature. It is integrated with a WPS cloud ecosystem of 678 million monthly active devices and turns skills into native, editable Word and PPT files.
